title: Uptime Monitoring (HTTP Check)
description: Always-on Compose-DNS probes from nexus otel-collector httpcheck (service.name=nexusflow.uptime): MinIO + collector health. Optional profiles (ClickHouse / SigNoz / Airflow) are not probed by default. ClickHouse SQL tuned for SigNoz standalone v0.117.

widgets.title: Availability (2xx) by URL
widgets.description: httpcheck.status for http.status_class=2xx. 1 = up. Lines may overlap when all healthy.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, avg(s.value) AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint AND s.metric_name = t.metric_name WHERE s.metric_name = 'httpcheck.status' AND JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'service.name') = 'nexusflow.uptime' AND JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'http.status_class') = '2xx' AND JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'http.url') = 'http://minio:9000/minio/health/live' AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp}} * 1000 AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp}} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Non-2xx status matches by URL
widgets.description: httpcheck.status value for classes other than 2xx (1 = that class matched). Healthy probes stay at 0. httpcheck.error is not emitted when a response is received, so this panel is the reliable failure signal.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, max(s.value) AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint AND s.metric_name = t.metric_name WHERE s.metric_name = 'httpcheck.status' AND JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'service.name') = 'nexusflow.uptime' AND JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'http.status_class') != '2xx' AND JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'http.url') = 'http://minio:9000/minio/health/live' AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp}} * 1000 AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp}} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
